diff --git a/textkit/core.py b/textkit/core.py
index 766a06c..4238efe 100644

+++ b/textkit/core.py
@@ -2,11 +2,14 @@ import re
 import textwrap
 
 _NON_WORD = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+")
+_GERMAN = str.maketrans(
+    {"ß": "ss", "ẞ": "SS", "ä": "a", "ö": "o", "ü": "u", "Ä": "A", "Ö": "O", "Ü": "U"}
+)
 
 
 def slug(text: str) -> str:
-    """'Hello, World!' -> 'hello-world'."""
-    words = [w for w in _NON_WORD.split(text) if w]
+    """'Hello, World!' -> 'hello-world'; 'Größe Über' -> 'grosse-uber'."""
+    words = [w for w in _NON_WORD.split(text.translate(_GERMAN)) if w]
     return "-".join(words).lower()
